FAQ

Common Questions

Do I need a license to operate a mini excavator?+
In most US states, no CDL or special license is required on private property. Check local regulations for commercial site requirements.
Does the machine come assembled?+
Yes. Every machine arrives fully assembled, tested, and ready to run. Fuel it, check the oil, start it.
What's included with every machine?+
Digging bucket, canopy (where applicable), operator manual, basic tool kit. See the 'What's In The Box' section above.
Can I trailer it with a pickup truck?+
The HY14G (1.4T) and HY10C (1T) tow behind a standard full-size pickup on an equipment trailer. The 1.7T models need a trailer rated for 2+ tons.
What attachments are compatible?+
All models accept standard hydraulic attachments — augers, hammers, additional buckets. Contact us with specific attachment questions.
How do I make a warranty claim?+
Email or call with your order number, serial number, and description. Our tech team responds within 1 business day.
How fast is delivery?+
7–12 business days after payment confirmation anywhere in the continental US. Tracking number sent at shipment.
Do you have a showroom I can visit?+
We sell direct online — it's how we keep prices competitive. Call or email our US team and we'll walk you through any machine in detail.

Questions

About the D902 Diesel Excavator

Why Kubota?

The D902 is the most widely used diesel engine in compact machinery. U.S. dealers stock parts and the engine has a separate manufacturer warranty.

Is it trailerable?

Yes. At 1.7 ton it requires a purpose-built equipment trailer with a 2,500 kg+ rating and appropriate tow vehicle.

Does it need red diesel?

No red-diesel rules in the US. Run standard diesel from any forecourt.

Questions

About the Enclosed Cab Excavator

Is the cab heated?

Yes — an operator cab heater is standard on every unit.

What does ROPS/FOPS mean?

Roll-Over Protective Structure and Falling Object Protective Structure. The cab is rated to protect the operator if the machine rolls or if objects fall onto the cab.

Is it trailerable?

Yes. At 1.7 ton it requires a purpose-built equipment trailer with a 2,500 kg+ rating.

Shipping Policy

All LandRaxx machines ship via freight carrier with free curbside delivery anywhere in the continental US.

Processing Time

Orders processed within 1–3 business days of payment. You'll receive a tracking number by email once shipped.

Delivery Time

Estimated 7–12 business days after shipment. Times vary by location.

What to Expect

Your machine arrives on a freight truck. Driver delivers to curb or nearest accessible point. A pallet jack or forklift may be required to move from curbside.

Freight Damage

Inspect before signing. Note any damage on delivery receipt and contact us within 24 hours at contact@landraxequipment.shop.

Return Policy

We accept returns within 30 days of delivery on new, unused machines.

Eligibility

  • New, unused condition in original crating
  • Fewer than 5 hours of operating time
  • Return initiated within 30 days of delivery

Process

Email contact@landraxequipment.shop with your order number and reason. We'll issue an RMA number and instructions.

Return Shipping

Return freight costs are the buyer's responsibility.

Refund Timeline

Refunds processed within 7–14 business days of receiving the returned machine.

Warranty Policy

Every LandRaxx machine carries a 12-month limited warranty from date of delivery.

Covered

  • Manufacturing defects in materials and workmanship
  • Hydraulic system components
  • Engine components (normal operation)
  • Structural frame defects

Not Covered

  • Normal wear (tracks, teeth, filters, fluids)
  • Misuse or unauthorized modifications
  • Damage from operating over rated capacity

Claims

Email contact@landraxequipment.shop with order number, serial number, and description. Response within 1 business day.
